Added vercel-labs/skills to my global toolchain. I'm just evaluating it at this point, but I suspect it can be used for declarative skills that are shared across multiple agentic coding tools. In that sense it's a bit duplicative of rulesync. I prefer how vercel has the ability to have symlinked .agents/skills to .claude/skills. I also like how it follows the "one thing well" philosophy. I could keep using rulesync for mcp and AGENTS.md synchronization, but maybe it's better to have a single purpose tool that manages AGENTS.md? Such a tool doesn't exist, at least as far as I know, but I haven't really searched hard for it.
